fields.statement: At e09d453f9, attempt 2: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestHealthMainOrphanLog -v -count=1 passes TestHealthMainOrphanLog (an untracked entry with no branch makes healthMain bad, Next and detail name the .rhiza/log/<cs>/ entry, its change set and rhiza model commit-untracked; a stale close-out keeps it bad instead of softening it to warn; after daemonCommitUntracked puts it on a model branch the part is ok with a pending entry listed) and TestHealthMainOrphanLogLiveRun (an entry a live run's worktree holds is pending, the part is ok, Next is empty, no 'on no branch' detail). go vet ./internal/api is clean; go test -run 'Health|Orphan|Untracked|ModelBranch|ModelPR|Check' ./internal/api passes in 27s. HealthResponse.ExitCode is 1 when any part is bad, so an orphan exits 1. Diff read: classifyUntrackedLog splits orphans from pending with the same branch/worktree logic as orphanLogEntries, and check.go still uses that logic. The whole internal/api package hit go test's default 600s timeout on a host with load ~12 on 4 cores; make test uses -timeout 20m and CI shards the package, so this is environmental and not caused by the change.
